cues.en: So the glove model comes from a very large matrix of word co-occurrences in text.
cues.zh: GloVe 模型來自一個很大的文字中單字共現矩陣。

cues.en: Basically, it's just counting how often words appeared next to each other in lots of data, and then factorizing that matrix to get a reduced dimensional representation.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是在大量資料中，計算單字相鄰出現的次數，再對矩陣做分解，取得低維表示。

cues.en: And that means that glove is really good at capturing more kind of global word frequency See characteristics and word pairs.
cues.zh: 因此，GloVe 很擅長捕捉比較全域的詞頻特徵與單字配對。

cues.en: Now word two vec, on the other hand, is trained from neural networks and is designed to predict a word given a context of surrounding words.
cues.zh: 另一方面，Word2vec 透過神經網路訓練，設計目的是根據周圍單字的上下文，預測某個單字。

cues.en: In fact, it's basically like what we trained our embeddings model to do a few sections ago.
cues.zh: 事實上，基本上就像前幾節訓練嵌入模型所做的事。

cues.en: So this difference in training means that word two vec is actually better at learning semantic relations across words.
cues.zh: 這個訓練差異，表示 Word2vec 其實更擅長學習單字之間的語意關係。

cues.en: So therefore word two vec is likely to be better at analogies compared to glove.
